Here’s a complete, production-ready workflow suite to **automatically generate & update PR descriptions** — including templates, extraction logic, and multi-trigger support.

---

## 📁 File 1: Auto-PR Description Generator
**Path:** `.github/workflows/auto-pr-description.yml`

```yaml
name: Auto PR Description
run-name: Generate description for PR #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  generate-description:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: >-
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      !contains(fromJson('["dependabot[bot]", "renovate[bot]", "github-actions[bot]"]'), github.actor)

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@692973e3d937129bcbf40652eb9f2f61becf3332@v4.2.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Extract change info
        id: info
        run: |
          PR_TITLE="${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          PR_BODY="${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
          PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          BASE_REF="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}"
          HEAD_REF="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}"
          AUTHOR="${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}"

          # Get changed files
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/- /' | head -30)
          if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
            CHANGED_FILES="- No file list available"
          fi

          # Get commit summary
          COMMITS=$(git log --format="- %s (%h)" "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD" 2>/dev/null | head -20)
          if [ -z "$COMMITS" ]; then
            COMMITS="- Commits unavailable"
          fi

          # Infer change type
          CHANGE_TYPE="Other"
          if echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE "^(feat:|feature:|add:|new:)"; then
            CHANGE_TYPE="Feature"
          elif echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE "^(fix:|bug:|hotfix:|resolve:)"; then
            CHANGE_TYPE="Bug Fix"
          elif echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE "^(docs:|doc:|documentation:|readme:)"; then
            CHANGE_TYPE="Documentation"
          elif echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE "^(refactor:|chore:|cleanup:|style:)"; then
            CHANGE_TYPE="Refactor"
          elif echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE "^(ci:|github:|workflow:|actions:)"; then
            CHANGE_TYPE="CI/CD"
          elif echo "$PR_TITLE" | grep -qiE "^(dep:|deps:|upgrade:|bump:)"; then
            CHANGE_TYPE="Dependency Update"
          fi

          echo "changed_files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$CHANGED_FILES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "commits<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$COMMITS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "change_type=$CHANGE_TYPE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "base_ref=$BASE_REF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "head_ref=$HEAD_REF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "author=$AUTHOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "title=$PR_TITLE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build PR Body
        id: build
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83021f400469cb355e61a7d140008035d7d@v7.0.1
        with:
          script: |
            const {
              change_type,
              pr_number,
              base_ref,
              head_ref,
              author,
              title,
              changed_files,
              commits
            } = ${{ toJSON(steps.info.outputs) }};

            const existingBody = context.payload.pull_request.body || '';
            const markerStart = '<!-- AUTO-PR-DESC:START -->';
            const markerEnd = '<!-- AUTO-PR-DESC:END -->';

            // Preserve user-written content outside markers
            let userContent = '';
            if (existingBody.includes(markerStart) && existingBody.includes(markerEnd)) {
              const parts = existingBody.split(markerEnd);
              userContent = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].trim() : '';
            } else if (existingBody.trim() !== '') {
              userContent = existingBody;
            }

            const autoSection = `${markerStart}
## 📋 Pull Request Summary

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Title** | ${title} |
| **Type** | ${change_type} |
| **Author** | @${author} |
| **Source** | \`${head_ref}\` |
| **Target** | \`${base_ref}\` |
| **PR #** | #${pr_number} |

### 📝 Commits
${commits}

### 📂 Files Changed
${changed_files}

---
*Auto-generated — edit below or above to customize*
${markerEnd}`;

            const newBody = userContent
              ? `${autoSection}\n\n---\n\n## ✍️ Notes\n${userContent}`
              : autoSection;

            console.log('Body length:', newBody.length);
            return newBody;

      - name: Update PR Description
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83021f400469cb355e61a7d140008035d7d@v7.0.1
        with:
          script: |
            const body = ${{ steps.build.outputs.result }};
            await github.rest.pulls.update({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
              body: body
            });
            console.log('✅ PR description updated');
```

---

## 📁 File 2: Standard PR Template
**Path:** `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`
*(Fills initial description; auto-generator enhances it)*

```markdown
<!-- AUTO-PR-DESC:START -->
<!-- Everything above/below this block will be preserved. DO NOT EDIT THE MARKERS. -->

## Change Type
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Breaking change

## Description
Brief summary of changes.

## Related
Closes #

## Validation
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Lint clean
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] No secrets exposed

## Notes
<!-- Add details, context, or screenshots here -->

<!-- AUTO-PR-DESC:END -->
```

---

## 📁 File 3: Label Auto-Assign
**Path:** `.github/workflows/auto-pr-labels.yml`
*(Companion — applies labels based on title/changed files)*

```yaml
name: Auto PR Labels
run-name: Auto-label PR #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/labeler@8558fd74291d68becae16e055fe952a2005241e7@v5.0.0
        with:
          configuration-path: .github/labeler-rules.yml
```

**Path:** `.github/labeler-rules.yml`
```yaml
ci:
  - changed-files:
      - any-glob-to-any-file: [".github/workflows/**", ".github/actions/**"]
documentation:
  - changed-files:
      - any-glob-to-any-file: ["docs/**", "*.md"]
python:
  - changed-files:
      - any-glob-to-any-file: ["**/*.py", "requirements*.txt", "pyproject.toml"]
javascript:
  - changed-files:
      - any-glob-to-any-file: ["**/*.js", "**/*.ts", "package.json"]
dependencies:
  - title: "^deps?:|^upgrade:|^bump:"
bug:
  - title: "^fix:|^bug:|^hotfix:"
feature:
  - title: "^feat:|^feature:|^add:"
```

---

## ✅ How It Works

| Feature | Behavior |
|---|---|
| **Triggers** | PR opened → fills description; push/update → refreshes file/commit list |
| **Preservation** | Content between `AUTO-PR-DESC` markers = auto-managed; everything else = yours to edit |
| **Change Type** | Detected from conventional commit prefix in title (`fix:`, `feat:`, `ci:`, etc.) |
| **Exclusions** | Skips dependabot/renovate bots to avoid noise |
| **Security** | Only runs on same-repo PRs; no cross-fork write access |

## 🚀 Setup
1. Save all 3 files above to your repo
2. Commit to `main`
3. Next PR you open → description auto-populates ✅

## 💡 Customization Tips
- **Keep manual notes** below the auto-block — they survive refreshes
- **Conventional titles** = better auto-detection: `fix: timeout issue`, `ci: update checkout to v4`
- **Pre-populate template** with your own checklists in `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`
- **Adjust file limits** in the script (`head -30` / `head -20`) to show more/less context
